# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.7 Route 4: Imperial Commerce, Chartered Banking & Exarchate Live Market Bridge (oe_eco_v97_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_eco_bridge_v97.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Inject a temporary special_demands entry into the country's capital market if one exists.
oe_eco_v97_inject_capital_demand = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = capital }
        capital = {
            if = {
                limit = { exists = market }
                market = {
                    add_temporary_demand = {
                        type = demand:$demand$
                        years = $years$
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Sovereign bond demand bridge across Constantinople, Venice, Genoa (plus non-overlapping capital).
oe_eco_v97_inject_bond_markets = {
    location:constantinople = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = market }
            market = {
                add_temporary_demand = {
                    type = demand:oe_eco_v97_sovereign_bond_boom
                    years = 3
                }
            }
        }
    }
    location:venice = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = market }
            market = {
                add_temporary_demand = {
                    type = demand:oe_eco_v97_sovereign_bond_boom
                    years = 3
                }
            }
        }
    }
    location:genoa = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = market }
            market = {
                add_temporary_demand = {
                    type = demand:oe_eco_v97_sovereign_bond_boom
                    years = 3
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = capital
            NOT = { capital = location:constantinople }
            NOT = { capital = location:venice }
            NOT = { capital = location:genoa }
        }
        oe_eco_v97_inject_capital_demand = { demand = oe_eco_v97_sovereign_bond_boom years = 3 }
    }
}

# Country scope. Human-only July O(1) market-cycle dispatcher (5-year cooldown between pulse events).
oe_eco_v97_july_cycle_dispatch = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_eco_v97_bond_stress = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_eco_v97_cycle_cd months = 60 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eco_v97.4
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            current_year >= 1343
            OR = {
                owns = location:jinjiang
                tag = CHI
                oe_far_has_east_exarch = yes
            }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_eco_v97_qz_cd }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_eco_v97_cycle_cd months = 60 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_eco_v97_qz_cd months = 120 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eco_v97.6
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            current_year >= 1343
            OR = {
                owns = location:alexandria
                has_country_modifier = oe_eco_v97_grain_stabilized
            }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_eco_v97_alex_cd }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_eco_v97_cycle_cd months = 60 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_eco_v97_alex_cd months = 120 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eco_v97.7
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            current_year >= 1343
            OR = {
                owns = location:venice
                owns = location:genoa
                has_country_modifier = oe_eco_v97_bond_service
                any_subject = { is_subject_type = oe_bank }
            }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_eco_v97_it_cd }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_eco_v97_cycle_cd months = 60 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_eco_v97_it_cd months = 120 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eco_v97.5
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            current_year >= 1343
            oe_eco_v97_has_bank_or_company = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_eco_v97_div_cd }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_eco_v97_cycle_cd months = 60 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_eco_v97_div_cd months = 120 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eco_v97.8
    }
}
